title: UK Athletics and the Home Country Athletics Federations: Adult Safeguarding Policy 2023 and Safeguarding Regulations
claims: The policy sets out roles and responsibilities at club, regional and national level, including a club welfare officer function.
Safeguarding referrals are assessed and may be referred to statutory safeguarding agencies or handled under internal regulations at different levels.
Clubs are expected to have accessible reporting routes and to respond to concerns about adults at risk as well as children.
